# facelesschamp-kit
Python 3.12+ framework over faceless-champ. Start with README.md and docs/api.md.
Use build(ctx) returning Video or a core composition. Keep content in reusable frozen blocks.
Compose fresh primitives in compose(ctx, bounds); finish layout before compilation.
Use segment-local times for play; narration markers reference original SRT cue numbers.
Use Segment.cue_time(original_index, edge="start", offset=0) for local cue times.
Segment.add/add_core accept at=0 and duration=None for delayed/finite lifetimes;
motions and entrances must fit their placement. Reports include source start/end.
FlowDiagram(steps, direction="horizontal"|"vertical") exposes node-N, label-N,
and edge-N children for transforms, color changes and Draw reveals.
ImageCard uses core ImageSlot for named boxes with matching image geometry.
TextPanel scales title/body allocation for compact grids; core fit_text does wrapping.
Preview uses the source clock. Validate and inspect before exporting; never infer full-export success from a frame.
Use provided CLI and Project services rather than copying render loops.
Read docs/catalog.md for block props and examples/custom_block.py for extension patterns.
For whiteboard videos, use templates.whiteboard_basic with immutable WhiteboardScene recipes and blocks.WhiteboardDrawing.
Start with `fc-kit init my-board --template whiteboard-basic`; read docs/whiteboard.md for geometry and cue timing.

HTML-to-video: see docs/html-to-video.md. Core faceless_champ.web owns HtmlPage, WebScript, capture_html, WebCapture, HtmlClip and timed visual controls. Kit WebWalkthrough/WebElement consume prepared captures. Browser installation is explicit; never perform a full export when only previews are requested.

OS UI: docs/os-ui.md; OSWalkthrough, FinderWindow, SettingsWindow; fc-kit init --template os-ui.

ChessChamp: docs/chesschamp.md; blocks.ChessBoard(script, theme=None, source_start=0), named child board; templates.chesschamp(ctx, data="data.json"); fc-kit init --template chesschamp. Install kit[chess]. JSON times are absolute within the script. Optional narration.audio is an asset ID. Audio-only Video.narration does not support cues/captions without subtitles.

Chess artwork defaults to bundled downloaded PNGs. ChessBoard assets= accepts core ChessAssets; data.json assets.directory resolves from the JSON directory. Core from_pgn/to_dict converts SAN game notation to timed data.json.
